videos.title: How to pitch a tent (in 5 minutes!) | Fjällräven Campfire Academy
videos.value: Shows the full multi-step process of pitching a tent alone — poles, footprint, staking corners, then the rainfly — a sequence a still image only shows the end result of.

videos.title: Scouting America: How to Tie and Use a Square Knot (Basic Approach)
videos.value: Shows the full tying motion for the square knot and a practical use, hand movements a static diagram doesn't capture.

videos.title: Scouting America: How to Tie Two Half Hitches
videos.value: Shows the full tying motion for two half-hitches and how each hitch snugs against the one before it as it's tied.

videos.title: Scouting America: How to Tie a Taut-Line Hitch
videos.value: Shows the full tying motion for the taut-line hitch and how sliding it along the main line adjusts tension, a dynamic action a still image can't convey.

videos.title: What to Do When an Adult is Choking (Responsive)
videos.value: Shows the full grip, positioning behind the person, and the repeated upward-and-inward thrust motion for abdominal thrusts, timing a still photo can't convey.

videos.title: Folding the American Flag - Boy Scouts of America Handbook Hacks
videos.value: Shows the full triangular folding sequence performed by two people from start to finish, a multi-step process a single photo can't capture.
